findings.summary: Missing mutation acknowledgement can be treated as success using a historical same-commit deployment.
findings.attribution: Author self-audit disclosed first; QA independently reproduced with exact frozen C3 provider adapter.
findings.repair: Bind authoritative later status to exact durable acknowledgement deployment ID; missing identity stays uncertain.

findings.summary: An ordinary uncertain migration observation/outcome cannot later reconcile to success.
findings.attribution: Independent migration continuation of root pending-observation concern.
findings.reproduction: One migration transport throws timeout, observer unavailable, uncertain observation+outcome retained. Reconcile with retained receipts throws already exists without new observation, even if current state would prove commit.
findings.repair: Allow bounded observer-only reconciliation with durable new observation/outcome records; preserve uncertain originals and never replay transport.

limits: During author C4 edits, C3 loader regression substituted only changed executor source/test from frozen C3 outer snapshot; all remaining nested source files read actual current bytes. Actual-current full closure must be rerun at successor freeze.
Fresh-process entrypoint integration not yet accepted; current reproductions use new journal instance and synthetic injected transport.
